title.en: MC14 in Yaoundé ends with limited results
title.zh: 雅溫得第14屆部長會議成果有限

summary.en: The March 2026 Ministerial Conference in Cameroon delivered only partial results, with key decisions sent back to Geneva.
summary.zh: 2026年3月在喀麥隆舉行的部長會議只取得部分成果，關鍵決定被送回日內瓦繼續談判。

question.en: Why is it so hard for 166 members to agree by consensus?
question.zh: 為什麼166個會員很難以共識決達成協議？

title.zh: 電子傳輸免關稅慣例出現變數

summary.en: At the October 2026 General Council, the EU called for urgent restoration of the moratorium on customs duties on electronic transmissions.
summary.zh: 在2026年10月總理事會上，歐盟呼籲盡快恢復電子傳輸免課關稅的暫停措施。

question.en: Should countries be allowed to charge tariffs on digital downloads and streaming?
question.zh: 各國是否應可對數位下載與串流服務課徵關稅？

title.en: Members push WTO reform before MC15
title.zh: 會員在第15屆部長會議前推動改革

summary.en: WTO members are holding more focused reform talks and seeking a clearer roadmap toward the next (15th) Ministerial Conference.
summary.zh: WTO會員加強聚焦改革討論，並尋求通往下屆（第15屆）部長會議更清楚的路線圖。

question.en: What is the most urgent WTO reform: dispute settlement, decision-making, or new rules?
question.zh: WTO最迫切的改革是什麼：爭端解決、決策方式，還是新規則？

text.zh: 烏拉圭回合結束，簽署馬拉喀什協定
中國加入，啟動杜哈回合
台灣以中華台北名義加入
第14屆部長會議於喀麥隆雅溫得舉行
